readme_excerpt: English | 简体中文 Chatbox (Community Edition) Your Ultimate AI Copilot on the Desktop. Chatbox is a desktop client for ChatGPT, Claude and other LLMs, available on Windows, Mac, Linux This is the repository for the Chatbox Community Edition, open-sourced under the GPLv3 license. Chatbox is going open-source Again! We regularly sync code from the pro repo to this repo, and vice versa.
